audience: coworking and flex-space operators who manage members and bookings with OfficeRnD

useCases.title: See which rooms are booked and by whom
useCases.text: Lists every booking occurrence between two times, with recurring bookings expanded, and lists resources such as meeting rooms and desks.

useCases.title: Review memberships and contracts up for renewal
useCases.text: Lists memberships with plan, price and status, and contracts with dates, notice period and lifecycle stage, to find those up for renewal.

useCases.title: Find unpaid or overdue invoices
useCases.text: Lists invoices, credit notes and overpayments with totals, paid and pending amounts, due dates and status, filtered by member, company or date.

useCases.title: Check who was on site and when
useCases.text: Lists member check-ins with the time and the booking or pass used, so you can summarize attendance and occupancy.

useCases.title: Book a resource for a member
useCases.text: Books a resource, such as a meeting room, for a member or company. It is charged by the resource's rate unless you set it as no charge or tentative.

useCases.title: Read, open or comment on helpdesk tickets
useCases.text: Lists helpdesk tickets with status and priority, opens a ticket for a member using the configured options, and posts a comment on a ticket.
